decisions.reason: The alleged sign contradiction presupposes an unstated Fourier/continuation convention. With the declared metric, U(t)=exp(-itH) indeed follows, but this is a valid positive-energy convention: Etingof's MIT notes section 11.7 define precisely that time-translation sign, and section 11.8, proof of Proposition 11.12, uses phi(v)=pi(v)phi(0)pi(-v), the same plus-shift conjugation. Independently, the spectral theorem gives <v,U(t)v>=integral exp(-itE) dmu_v(E) with mu_v supported on E>=0; at t=-i tau it becomes <v,exp(-tau H)v> for tau>0. Reversing the chosen continuation/Fourier convention causes no negative-energy spectrum or obstruction. The item fixes neither conflicting convention. This rejects this exact tuple only; two distinct formulation defects are referred separately below, without editing a false-positive item.

ledger_updates.location: Open problem: canonical local-polynomial paragraph and stronger-variant gauge-field-content paragraph
ledger_updates.reason: Distinct finding, not the assigned sign objection: D_A=d+[A,.] on exterior forms satisfies D_A F_A=0 by the Bianchi identity. Consequently the stated iterates D_A^k F_A vanish for k>=1 and do not provide the tensor covariant derivatives required for local differential-polynomial labels. In a local Cartesian chart take nonzero T in the Lie algebra and A=(x^1)^2 T dx^2. Then F_12=2x^1 T and D_A F_A=0, while the component covariant derivative nabla^A_1 F_12=2T is nonzero. The stated label space and dimension filtration omit the intended derivative labels, contrary to the curvature-and-covariant-derivatives requirement in Jaffe-Witten section 4.
ledger_updates.proposed_repair: Define the tensor covariant derivative in Cartesian coordinates by (nabla^A_lambda T)_{mu_1...mu_r}=partial_lambda T_{mu_1...mu_r}+[A_lambda,T_{mu_1...mu_r}] for every smooth adjoint-valued covariant r-tensor; iterate it without antisymmetrizing derivative slots. Use all finite iterates of this operator on F_A in both label definitions, and assign nabla^A dimension one. Keep the exterior operator D_A separately if used. Mirror the repaired formulation in the owning manifest and contract under the shared lock, then perform ordinary interface-consumer checks.

ledger_updates.location: Open problem: stronger-variant Wightman-realization paragraph, tensor covariance identity
ledger_updates.reason: Distinct finding, not the assigned sign objection: for a component column with rho a representation, the law U(g)Phi(x)U(g)^-1=rho(Lambda)Phi(gx) reverses matrix order under successive conjugations. Conjugating first by g_2 and then by g_1 yields rho(Lambda_2)rho(Lambda_1)Phi(g_1 g_2 x), while direct conjugation by U(g_1 g_2) yields rho(Lambda_1)rho(Lambda_2)Phi(g_1 g_2 x). Tensor representations of noncommuting spatial rotations do not satisfy this identity in general. The problem affects the declared nonscalar fields, including the stress tensor; restricting to scalar labels would lose approved scope.
ledger_updates.proposed_repair: Specify column components and replace the matrix prefactor by rho(Lambda^-1), retaining the argument Lambda x+a. Its composition gives rho(Lambda_2^-1)rho(Lambda_1^-1)=rho((Lambda_1 Lambda_2)^-1). State the associated test-function/dual-index convention and check the stress-tensor components. Reconcile only affected owning metadata under the shared lock and perform ordinary interface-consumer checks; the translation sign need not change.
